map.依据 Light 标准(胸水/血清蛋白比值、LDH比值、胸水LDH)判别胸腔积液: Distinguish pleural effusion nature by the Light criteria (pleural/serum protein ratio, LDH ratio, pleural LDH)
map.结合血清上限: Combined with the serum upper limit
map.：胸水蛋白 3.5/血清 6.0=0.583>0.5→满足一条，判渗出液。: : pleural protein 3.5 / serum 6.0 = 0.583 > 0.5 -> one criterion met, judged exudate.
map.：胸水 LDH 250/血清 LDH 200=1.25>0.6，或胸水 LDH>: : pleural LDH 250 / serum LDH 200 = 1.25 > 0.6, or pleural LDH above 2/3 of the serum upper limit -> exudate.

map.三条满足几条？: How many of the three criteria must be met?
map.满足任一条即渗出；漏出液三条均不满足。: Meeting any one criterion means exudate; a transudate meets none of the three.
map.心衰/低蛋白时可出现\"假性渗出\"，需结合临床与 NT-proBNP。: In heart failure or hypoproteinaemia a 'pseudo-exudate' can appear, so read it with the clinical picture and NT-proBNP.
